title: Claudette: A Tool to Simplify Claude AI's Verbose Responses
summary: Claudette is an open-source tool (GitHub project) designed to convert Claude AI's verbose, BuzzFeed-style responses into concise, engineer-friendly language. It leverages the Gemini CLI to translate Claude's output while preserving technical accuracy, offering different modes for engineers, managers, and executives. The tool addresses a common frustration with Claude's overly dramatic or clickbait-like phrasing in technical discussions.
key_points: Claudette is a Claude Code skill that reformats Claude AI's responses to remove excessive theatrics and clickbait-style language.
It uses Gemini CLI to translate responses into plain English while preserving technical details like file paths and code blocks.
Three output modes: 'colleague' (default, detailed for engineers), 'manager' (shorter, no code), and 'director' (executive summary).
Works by piping Claude's output to Gemini with style instructions, ensuring no reintroduction of the original verbose tone.
Requires Claude Code and authenticated Gemini CLI (`npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`).
Open-source (MIT license) and available on GitHub for installation via simple commands.
Handles errors transparently, showing Gemini's errors directly or falling back to a labeled Claude rewrite if needed.
